description: Canalisation_eau_de_mer is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Identification of pipelines for the supply or discharge of seawater for maritime activities on the coast of the Department of the English Channel. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Canalisation_water_de_mer" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include DDTM50, pompage, eau de mer, adduction, canalisation, DPM. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
